Which of the following is the best interpretation of the survey results?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice C is correct. It&rsquo;s given that an estimated 38% of sampled students at the school were in support of a menu change, with a margin of error of 5.5%. The lower bound of this estimation is \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"38 minus 5 point 5\">\x3C/span>, or 32.5%. The upper bound of this estimation is \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"38 plus 5 point 5\">\x3C/span>, or 43.5%.
